# looot-skills

> Agent skills for looot: 10 skills that run free, 20 paid data jobs and the base skill. Install with npx skills add loootai/looot-skills, or as a Claude Code plugin with /plugin marketplace add loootai/looot-skills then /plugin install looot-skills@looot-skills.

looot is one key and one prepaid balance for 4,392 data API endpoints from 324 providers. The agent searches the catalog, sees the price before it runs, and pays per call. A new account gets $2 of credit once, so the first paid runs need no top-up; after that, top-ups are $5 minimum. Searching and inspecting are free, and $0 endpoints run even at a $0 balance.

## Free skills ($0 per run, no top-up needed)

- looot-website-tech-stack: technology groups a domain uses (BuiltWith free API)
- looot-cve-exploited-check: whether a CVE is on the CISA known exploited list, with CVSS (NIST NVD)
- looot-clinical-trials-search: clinical studies by condition, drug, sponsor or place (ClinicalTrials.gov)
- looot-lei-company-lookup: a company's LEI, legal name and addresses (GLEIF)
- looot-sec-filings: a US public company's CIK, profile and recent filings (SEC EDGAR)
- looot-research-papers: papers by topic with citations and DOI (OpenAlex)
- looot-npm-package-check: npm package version, license, provenance and security advisories (npm registry, OSV.dev)
- looot-vehicle-recalls: VIN decode and US safety recalls (NHTSA)
- looot-fda-drug-recalls: FDA drug recall enforcement reports (openFDA)
- looot-sanctions-check: a name against the OFAC SDN, UK and EU sanctions lists

## Paid skills (paid per call: $2 of credit once for a new account, then $5 top-ups)

looot-ai-search-visibility, looot-amazon-product, looot-backlink-checker, looot-company-email-format, looot-company-list-builder, looot-domain-keywords, looot-email-verification, looot-enrich-a-company, looot-enrich-a-person, looot-find-phone-numbers, looot-find-professional-emails, looot-google-maps-reviews, looot-google-serp, looot-job-postings, looot-keyword-volume, looot-local-business-search, looot-meta-ads-library, looot-reddit-search, looot-tiktok-search, looot-youtube-transcript

## Install

- Remote MCP server: `claude mcp add --transport http looot https://api.looot.ai/mcp`
- CLI: npm install -g looot@1.4.0, then looot login
- This repo: npx skills add loootai/looot-skills
- Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add loootai/looot-skills, then /plugin install looot-skills@looot-skills
- looot plugin (MCP server, core skill, /looot:setup, /looot:find, /looot:balance): /plugin install looot@looot-skills in Claude Code, or codex plugin marketplace add loootai/looot-skills then codex plugin add looot@looot-skills in Codex
